🗳️ Lancashire is the last part of the North without an elected mayor — and Westminster would very much like that to change.

🤔 But here's the question nobody has put to the 1.5 million people who live here: DO YOU WANT ONE?

📋 Reform UK's leader at County Hall, Cllr Stephen Atkinson, is calling for a binding referendum before any council is abolished or any mayor created.

⏸️ Reorganisation has been paused pending lawfulness checks — a setback of at least 18 months. The clock everyone was being rushed against has already stopped.

✅ So ask the people. If Lancashire votes yes, fair enough. What isn't fair is a settlement imposed by people who never put the question. 👇
